runtimeArtifacts.notes: Seven filesystem/content/budget negatives used the initial artifact; final positive and tiny-fraction rejection used the final artifact. The POI budget and secure filesystem reader source was unchanged between artifacts. The final artifact adds strict Boolean argument validation.

unitTests.evidence: Successful explicit Maven invocation with JVM startup argLine below; its XML was subsequently overwritten by a parallel default-tempdir run.

temporaryOutputEnvironment: On macOS /var and /tmp are symlinks. An initial default-tempdir run failed the existing EtlFileStore security check. A JVM-startup argLine selecting the real /private/tmp directory passes all 12 tests without changing security checks.
authorization: Integration consumer resolves task-authorized resourceBindingId and connector code before compile.
Worker root allowlist is separately deployed by administrator; empty denies all reads.
SecureDirectoryStream NOFOLLOW handles reject symlink files and parent directories.
Upload fileId and arbitrary URL never authorize worker file reads.
remainingBoundaries: POI dependencies and DH_READ_EXCEL must be registered in the worker session, and managedFunctions must declare DH_READ_EXCEL.
LITERAL and saved CACHED formulas are supported; formulas and external workbook links are never recalculated.
Unsupported field length/type conversions are rejected; BigNumber length/precision explicitly maps to DECIMAL(p,s).
